subject.title: feat: add plugin verify evidence endpoint

question: Should ClawHub expose this public plugin verify endpoint now, and if so must provenance be selected-release-only with current trusted-publisher config split out?
rationale: The endpoint defines fields that clients may automate trust decisions against, so the permanent boundary between release evidence, current package configuration, and future vetted-community review status needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Require release-scoped evidence before merge
options.body: Make `provenance` use only the selected release, expose mutable package config separately if needed, and require live HTTP proof before taking the PR out of draft.

options.title: Expose current config explicitly
options.body: Allow current trusted-publisher or package verification state in the response only under a clearly named mutable-current-config field with docs and tests.

options.title: Pause behind the trust RFC
options.body: Leave the PR draft or close it later if maintainers decide the broader vetted-community policy should land before any plugin verify API.

recommendation.title: Require release-scoped evidence before merge
recommendation.body: Make `provenance` use only the selected release, expose mutable package config separately if needed, and require live HTTP proof before taking the PR out of draft.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the recent package trust/API contributor and already engaged on whether this PR should continue.
